title: Session handoff: glyph-cli 36c6f5f9 onto its successor (context budget)
description: Renewal handoff for the glyph-cli worker at a clean boundary; the implementation notes are the content.
implementationNotes:
Session handoff for the glyph-cli worker (session 36c6f5f9, model route: claude-sonnet-5-5, the Sonnet 5.5 build, a native teammate of the opum-agent leader) onto its successor, DEC-158 renewal at a clean boundary over the context budget, 2026-11-17. STATE AT WRITE: origin/dev f5c4ead347885ac46a9d3a601ecb69a28070a96a before this handoff PR; origin/main 63577d4318f30f9c34ecd392b5db874482ad0bf7, UNTOUCHED, nothing promoted this session (promotion is the leader's call and was declined for today). Working tree clean, no open pull requests, nothing In Progress.

LANDED THIS SESSION, all through reviewed PRs into dev: GCLI-37 (opum-ai/glyph-cli#84, squash 678c5fd; code-map tier 3, symbols resolved through the index; DEC-216 (a4)(c), (a6) Q2, (a9) distance ordering) with its close-out #85 (d97958f); GCLI-38 (#86, squash e0807cd; the code-map time budget; DEC-216 (a4)(b) and (a10); ADR 0005 Accepted) with its close-out #87 (f5c4ead). GCLI-37 and GCLI-38 are Done and in .quest/completed/.

GCLI-12 AND ITS CHILDREN: GCLI-12 (slice 4, glyph code-map and opum-cli integration) and GCLI-36 (12a) still read To Do on the tracker although their work is delivered: 12a landed as GCLI-40 (pure layer) and GCLI-41 (command, tiers 1, 2 and 4, byte parity to opum-cli 91542f4), 12b as GCLI-37, 12c as GCLI-38; all four are Done. I did not change GCLI-12 or GCLI-36: whether to complete them, and what remains of the opum-cli integration half of GCLI-12, is the leader's and opum-doc's call. Verify before assuming either way.

DESIGN OF RECORD, each recorded verbatim on the task that carries it: DEC-216 (a4)(b)/(c), (a6) Q2, (a7), (a8), (a9) on GCLI-37 and GCLI-41; (a10) and the measurement on GCLI-38 and GCLI-12. The budget is the single constant CODE_MAP_TIME_BUDGET_MS = 7_000 in src/codemap-text.ts; changing it needs a new measurement and a new record, never an edit alone (a pin test holds it). The reopen condition for a subprocess index build (option B) is a real repository whose cold build alone exceeds the budget.

GCLI-18 IS HELD (label hold): readBlobs must fail indeterminate on a missing or ambiguous object. It stays held until the leader sends a brief; do not start it.

CARRIED ITEMS, non-blocking, for the next PR that touches test/codemap-budget.test.ts (also verbatim on the completed GCLI-38): N6, the 'budget already spent' test (timeBudgetMs: 0) runs rev-parse with a 1 ms timeout, so its stage is 'source ref' or 'named paths' depending on timing; pin it with now: () => 0 if determinism matters. N7, the exact mid-run pin is tied to how many times the code reads the clock (an added now() call moves it); a comment beside the pin would save the next editor a search. One more, from my own mutation runs: P3 (the in-suite warm test) has no mutant of its own beyond the budget constant.

OTHER TASKS, all To Do, not started, none admitted: GCLI-39 (the DEC-216 (a6) rulings: barrel namespace importers, import {} as a module edge, export = namespace as unresolved), GCLI-35 (GCLI-11 review nits plus the (i)-(iii) notes), GCLI-34 (ADR 0002 exit-family wording), GCLI-33 (DEC-278, the ref cache hashing arm), GCLI-26 to GCLI-31 (the earlier follow-ups). Three producer defects in opum-cli's deterministic producer (quadratic extractors, a leading-dot path read, non-ASCII grep paths quoted) are ported as is for parity and recorded on GCLI-41; filing them upstream is opum-cli's, through the leader.

REVIEW WORKTREES under .claude/worktrees/ stay in place (DEC-208): 32 review-* directories are registered, including this session's review-84-323d0f3, review-84-49e3c3c, review-84-a12aa1f, review-86-a8c992a, review-86-3b5593a and review-86-c2135fe. Do not remove, deregister or prune any.

MECHANICS THAT COST TIME: quest and lore are 0.14.1 under ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin; prepend per call and do not touch the nvm default (DEC-266). bun is at ~/.bun/bin. The opum-workflow hooks refuse git commit while on dev, refuse git push composed with any other command (run it bare), and refuse an unescaped backtick inside a double-quoted argument (pass bodies with --body-file or a file). The ownership guard refuses shell-built paths such as $VAR/file, so use literal absolute paths. Scratch files go under the session scratchpad, not /tmp. Quest actor: glyph-cli-worker, delegated-agent, accountable human jdnewhouse. Land each reviewed PR with gh pr merge N --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <the cleared head> as one bare call, then confirm the dev push run green by the full SHA. lore sync adds dated docs/log.md entries from git history; revert docs/log.md. The loop on every code task: floor, branch off dev, build, register each new rule's mutant and its prediction first, run it so exactly its own test reddens, green head, a detached review worktree .claude/worktrees/review-<pr>-<short sha>, the head SHA and path to the leader, no merge until a verdict. A measured lesson: a time-budget test that depends on real git timing is flaky on the CI runner; use an injected clock or a git shim.
finalSummary: Renewal handoff written and completed at write; the implementation notes carry the state.
